excerpt: Newfront is a San Francisco insurance and benefits brokerage built on its own technology. WTW acquired it in a deal worth up to $1.3 billion, completed in January 2026.
content:
Newfront is an insurance brokerage. It helps businesses buy commercial insurance, such as property, casualty, cyber, executive risk and aviation cover, and helps employers run employee benefits and retirement plans, which it groups under Total Rewards. What set it apart from traditional brokers was its own software: clients get dashboards and data about their policies, claims and costs, and the company says it uses technology, including AI, to lower clients' total cost of risk. Newfront describes itself as a modern brokerage working across more than 20 industries, and WTW called it a San Francisco-based, top-40 US broker with strengths in technology, fintech and life sciences clients. Spike Lipkin is its co-founder and CEO.

Acquisition by WTW

On 10 December 2025 the global broker WTW agreed to buy Newfront. Financier Worldwide reported that the deal was worth up to $1.3 billion: $1.05 billion up front, made up of about $900 million in cash and $150 million in equity for Newfront employee-shareholders, plus up to $250 million more, mostly in equity, if Newfront meets performance targets. WTW said Newfront had grown organic revenue at a 20% compound annual rate from 2018 to 2024. On 27 January 2026 Newfront announced that WTW had completed the acquisition. Newfront's Business Insurance arm is now part of WTW's Risk & Broking segment and its Total Rewards arm part of WTW's Health, Wealth & Career segment, and Lipkin joined WTW to lead integration, client development, talent and technology. Newfront's website now says it has officially joined WTW.

Pricing

Newfront does not charge a published price. Like other brokers, it is typically paid through commissions or fees on the insurance and benefits it places, agreed client by client.

Who it suits

Newfront suits US mid-market companies, especially in technology, fintech and life sciences, that want a broker for business insurance and employee benefits with strong data tools. Individuals looking for personal car or home insurance are not its focus.

This page is based on Newfront's website and announcements, WTW's deal announcement and Financier Worldwide.
